name: atlas-mem
description: Four independent dials — compression (low/high), rigour (ask), check and silent — plus five subagents that keep searches, logs, pages and big files out of your conversation. Compresses without losing a fact, and refuses to start building before the goal is clear. This variant adds review, build fixing and a memory: notes written by hand, linked to code, and flagged as suspect when that code or what it depends on changes.
